# CAB Validation r1-r4-ebgp-v4

## Summary: FAIL

## Deploy Result: Success - Lab 'r1-r4-ebgp-v4' deployed (new), configs committed on r1/r4.

## r1 Interface:
```
ethernet-1/1 is up, speed 25G
  ethernet-1/1.0 is up
    IPv4 addr    : 172.16.99.1/30 (static, preferred, primary)
```
Status: ✅ UP + correct IP

## r1 BGP Neighbor 172.16.99.2:
```
| default              | 172.16.99.2                    | ebgp-r4              | S      | 65001      | active           | -                |                |                                |
```
Status: ❌ state=active (not Established), TCP connection None

## r1 BGP Routes ipv4 summary:
```
Received routes: 0
2 received BGP routes: 2 used, 2 valid (local only: 1.1.1.1/32, 172.16.99.0/30)
```
Status: ❌ rx_count=0 (no peer Lo0)

## r4 Interface:
```
ethernet-1/1 is up, speed 25G
  ethernet-1/1.0 is up
    IPv4 addr    : 172.16.99.2/30
```
Status: ✅ UP + correct IP

## r4 BGP Neighbor 172.16.99.1:
```
| default              | 172.16.99.1                    | ebgp-r1              | S      | 65000      | active           | -                |                |                                |
```
Status: ❌ state=active (not Established)

## r4 BGP Routes ipv4 summary:
```
Received routes: 0
2 received BGP routes: 2 used, 2 valid (local only)
```
Status: ❌ rx_count=0

## CAB Gate: FAIL

**Reasons**:
- BGP sessions stuck in 'active' state (TCP not connecting, ports [0]->[0])
- No routes received/exchanged (rx_count=0)
- Ping fails (possible routing/PATH issue, but interfaces L3 up)
